subject.title: Add option to hide session status card

question: Should OpenClaw add a core status-card visibility config for chat `/status` and `session_status`, and should it hide the whole card or only sensitive sections such as usage and cost?
rationale: The implementation path is source-clear, but the permanent config key, output shape, privacy default, and compatibility contract are product-owned decisions.

options.title: Add a documented visibility contract
options.body: Introduce a default-on setting or section allowlist that preserves existing output while allowing operators to suppress the chat/tool status card or sensitive lines.

options.title: Limit scope to privacy sections
options.body: Add only usage/cost suppression if maintainers want to solve the sensitive-data concern without creating a broad status-card mode.

options.title: Reject the new config surface
options.body: Keep status cards always visible and close the request as not planned if the extra configuration is not worth the complexity.

recommendation.title: Add a documented visibility contract
recommendation.body: Introduce a default-on setting or section allowlist that preserves existing output while allowing operators to suppress the chat/tool status card or sensitive lines.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is tied to the current status path and already framed this issue as the canonical tracker in the discussion.
